messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "some patients may not experience adequate analgesia for the first 24 hours"
set: ["some patients may not experience adequate analgesia for the first 24 hours", "titration should provide adequate analgesia", "once-daily dose may not keep blood pressure controlled for the full 24 hours", "about 24 hours", "sertraline stays in the body for about 24 hours", "some patients may not need extra potassium at all", "up to 24 hours", "24 hours or longer", "do not take another dose for at least 24 hours", "5 mg orally after 24 hours", "24 mg for HEC", "5 more patients 18 to 24", "within 24 hours: some people get complete relief", "significant weight loss in some patients", "30 mg over the first hour, then 12.5 mg per hour for the subsequent 4 hours", "some young people may have thoughts about suicide when first taking antidepressant"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
